record.title: Execute acquired-input persistence with reconciled storage contract
record.intent: Obtain one bounded original-consumer installation and persistence result.
requirements: Use a fresh run identity and unchanged acquired-option fixture with stock APK and native file pins.
Execute one frozen guest-only loopback-confined run; no physical contact.
Record one FlexA installer call and original consumer witnesses plus exact catalog and file deltas.
If accepted, reload in a new component process and after the same guest reboots without regeneration, reinstall or formatting.
Stop on first discrepancy. Preserve and independently verify evidence with the existing verifier; do not change an experiment to force acceptance.
Commit and push the actual conclusion before successor execution.
acceptance: A sealed success or first reproducible failure is recorded.
